cases.name: Kyra Franchetti
cases.about:
Her mom, Jacqueline described her this way: “Kyra was a fiercely independent, giggly happy toddler. She loved Elmo and Mickey Mouse. She loved bubbles. She loved to be on the swings. She wanted to go fast. She’d go on the slides all the time,” Franchetti said. “The last day that I had with her, she just learned how to roll down a hill and she was really proud of her latest accomplishment.”

https://www.newsday.com/long-island/nassau/child-safety-court-legislation-1.37856387

Foundation started by her mom: https://charitysmith.org/memorial-funds/kyra-franchetti/
cases.narrative: He shot her twice in the back while she slept, set the house on fire after killing her, then killed himself.
